one_liner_zh: 家得寶上季營收與獲利雙雙優於預期，受惠於旺季需求及專業客戶業務穩健成長。
one_liner_en: Home Depot posted better-than-expected revenue and earnings, driven by strong seasonal demand and steady professional customer growth.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：每股盈餘 4.92 美元高於預期之 4.73 美元。
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘達 4.92 美元，優於市場預期的 4.73 美元
總營收達 47.86 億美元，較去年同期成長 5.71%
專業承包商（Pro）業務維持穩健動能
供應鏈效率提升支撐了利潤率表現
highlights_en: EPS of $4.92 beat the consensus estimate of $4.73
Total revenue reached $47.86 billion, up 5.71% year-over-year
Professional contractor (Pro) segment maintained steady momentum
Supply chain efficiency improvements supported margin performance
risks_zh: 高利率環境持續壓抑大型居家裝修與房市交易動能
總體經濟不確定性可能導致消費者延後非必要支出
risks_en: High interest rate environment continues to pressure large-scale home remodeling and housing turnover
Macroeconomic uncertainty may cause consumers to defer discretionary spending
ai_view_zh: 觀點：財報展現強韌的營運執行力，優於市場對房市疲軟的擔憂。短中期來看，專業客戶的市佔擴張有助於抵消零售端的遲緩，對股價偏向正面。追蹤指標應關注房貸利率走勢、客單價變化及大型專案支出意願。
ai_view_en: View: The earnings demonstrated resilient operational execution, easing market concerns over housing headwinds. In the near to medium term, Pro segment market share gains help offset retail sluggishness, providing a positive bias for the stock. Key metrics to track include mortgage rate trends, average ticket size, and large project spending appetite.
